status: 46 functions reviewed; 16 refined definitions; grouped build passes all 15,169 fixed entry slots.

source_reviews.name: card_bring_to_light
source_reviews.reason: Native 0x2457df2 test/0x2457df4 jns accepts only nonnegative tutor results after unconditional CSV-to-IID conversion. Restore >=0 instead of !=-1. Conversion, land check, legality query, chooser, play, kill and basic-spell continuation keep their order.

source_reviews.name: card_guardian_idol
source_reviews.reason: Native artifact_animation returns at 0x202f0e8, which writes the original player argument for get_card_instance at 0x202f0ef. The source instead reloaded parent_controller after animation. Use original player for the created legacy, preserving parent-based animation arguments and native player==IS_AI(player) quirk.

source_reviews.name: card_elder_pine_of_jukai
source_reviews.reason: Native reloads deck_ptr[player] separately for each reveal (second at 0x20b2950), then snapshots the scan pointer after count_deck at 0x20b29ad and only for positive count. Remove the source pointer cached before both show_deck callbacks. Preserve fresh current_turn for second reveal and saved scan pointer afterward.

source_reviews.name: cast_counter_triggered_ability
source_reviews.reason: Use separate stack index, selected card, target instance and IID roles. Preserve fresh stack_size after getter, stack_size-2 even when stack has one entry, target stores before IID queries, second getter on -1 and byte-sized target-count update.

source_reviews.name: bloodcrazed_hoplite_effect
source_reviews.reason: Share can_target continuation and restore countdown loop. Each iteration still queries instance before target construction; native AI/speculation predicate adds counter restriction, failed target availability exits and failed selection consumes one iteration.

source_reviews.name: card_shared_animosity
source_reviews.reason: Use descending attacker/ascending other-creature scans and a named bounded count. Preserve in_play/type/attacking/subtype callback order, fresh inner bound after callbacks and no pump for zero shared attackers.

source_reviews.name: card_knight_of_the_widget
source_reviews.reason: Restore c/IID/widget-count roles and a forward scan; native watermark query precedes permanent test. Negative IID fallback, fresh active-card bound and characteristic-PT update for zero count remain.

source_reviews.name: new_special_count_grave
source_reviews.reason: Separate saved grave cursor, current IID, test score and bounded match count. Preserve pointer increment before callback and next IID load after it. The matcher intentionally receives original player, including ANYBODY, rather than loop player.

source_reviews.name: fx_when_creature_attacks_it_gains_p1
source_reviews.reason: Restore milled-trigger and creature-count roles. Use forward scan with live num_cards_milled, retain invalid-source skip, empty/noncreature early returns and both separate post-creation getter calls.

source_reviews.name: patient_rebuilding_legacy
source_reviews.reason: Replace nested do/count idiom with forward live-bound land scan and one post-scan draw decision. Preserve matching-controller trigger guards, invalid-source skip and exile after optional draw.

source_reviews.name: ereboss_titan_effect
source_reviews.reason: Recover reverse scan and preview-card role. Preserve one initial grave count, fresh grave pointer/hand count per candidate, old grave index across chooser/discard and unconditional preview obliteration after choice.

source_reviews.name: count_permanents_you_control_but_you_dont_own
source_reviews.reason: Restore two-player/reverse-card scans and bounded stolen count. Keep native player-selector quirk (loop p==ANYBODY, not input player==ANYBODY), with in_play then type then stolen queries.

source_reviews.name: card_ghoulraiser
source_reviews.reason: Separate saved grave pointer, live count, candidate list and selected grave index. Preserve initial nonempty guard, count_graveyard before first/after every candidate, fixed native 60-entry array without added cap, RNG before selected IID and add before removal.

source_reviews.name: card_sage_of_ancient_lore
source_reviews.reason: Replace sign-bit De Morgan expression with its exact signed predicates player>=0 && card>=0. Preserve event-range/affected guards, helper order, ETB draw and characteristic hand-count read.

source_reviews.name: activate_oran_rief_pump
source_reviews.reason: Restore ordinary two-player/reverse-card scans. Keep per-player initial bound snapshots, in_play/type/just-entered checks and explicit sleighted-color-before-creature-color sequence before counter callback.

source_reviews.name: card_amareth_the_lustrous
source_reviews.reason: Use existing shared TUTOR_0 enum and name temporary preview_card by its role. Preserve saved library pointer before entered-type callback, top IID read after callback, temporary card getter/obliteration and boolean qty snapshot after test constructor.
